maes_4.why: Algebra involves solving for variables using established methods that I have practiced extensively.

maes_5.why: Trigonometry introduces new concepts like sine and cosine, which take time to fully grasp.

maes_6.why: Area and volume calculations are routine once familiar with formulas for basic shapes.

maes_7.why: Sketching curves requires visualization skills that I am still developing.

maes_8.why: Fractions are foundational to many math topics and I have consistent practice with them.

maes_9.why: Determining missing side lengths involves applying theorems like Pythagoras, which requires careful thought.
